words.definition: A preliminary model of a product or design

sentence.translation: कंपनी ने अपने नए स्मार्टफोन की विशेषताओं का परीक्षण करने के लिए एक प्रोटोटाइप बनाया।

sentence.sentence: The designer built a prototype of the chair to see how it would look in the room.

words.definition: Designed to reduce physical strain or discomfort
words.definationTranslation: शारीरिक तनाव या असुविधा को कम करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया

words.definition: Able to be maintained or supported without harm to the environment

words.definition: A point of interaction between two systems or devices

words.definition: The quality of being easy to use or operate

words.definition: A repeated process of refining or improving a design

words.definition: The introduction of new or original ideas, methods, or products

words.definition: A model or representation of a design or product

words.definition: A visual representation of a design or product

words.definition: The way in which something is arranged or organized

words.definition: Representing or symbolizing something, especially a concept or idea

sentence.sentence: The iconic logo of the company is recognized worldwide.

sentence.sentence: The designer created an iconic design for the new product.

words.definition: Having or characterized by a minimal amount of decoration or ornamentation
words.definationTranslation: न्यूनतम सजावट या अलंकरण की मात्रा होना या इसकी विशेषता होना

sentence.sentence: The minimalist design of the new product made it stand out.

sentence.sentence: The company improved the accessibility of their product for people with disabilities.

words.definition: The quality of being able to work or function together

sentence.sentence: The company ensured the compatibility of their product with different devices.

words.definition: Able to respond quickly and effectively to a situation or stimulus
words.definationTranslation: एक स्थिति या उत्तेजना के लिए जल्दी और प्रभावी ढंग से प्रतिक्रिया देने में सक्षम

sentence.sentence: The company's responsive website design made it easy to navigate on mobile devices.

sentence.sentence: The designer created a responsive layout for the new application.

words.definition: The ability of a system or product to handle increased load or demand

sentence.sentence: The company's scalable software solution helped them grow their business.
